entry.text: Senior Software Engineer | Offshore Team Lead    Aug 2025 – May 2026
Description: Enterprise-scale telecommunications application for Verizon Business customers, built with Micro Frontend and Microservices
architecture, enabling customers to manage business network services, monitor connectivity, configure enterprise solutions, and access digital self-
service capabilities.
Responsibility:
• Led and coordinated an offshore team of developers, ensuring successful sprint execution and on-time delivery of project milestones.
• Partnered with business stakeholders, architects, and product owners to gather requirements and translate real-world business and network
structures into system models.
• Drove System Design and Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to model complex
hierarchies and relationships across network and billing domains.
• Developed and maintained backend microservices and REST APIs using Java 21 and Spring Boot, leveraging modern language features (records,
pattern matching, and virtual threads) to improve concurrency, service performance, and maintainability.
• Implemented event-driven integrations using Kafka to support asynchronous processing and consistency across multiple dependent services.
• Built and maintained Micro Frontend applications using React.js, TypeScript, and Module Federation, improving modularity and independent
deployability.
• Designed and built ETL and batch-processing microservices with Node.js to extract, transform, and load network usage and billing data across
enterprise systems on a scheduled basis.
• Integrated an AI-powered chatbot into the customer self-service portal to automate common support queries and cut down manual ticket volume.
• Conducted code reviews and mentored team members to raise development standards across the team.
• Managed source code through Git workflows and supported CI/CD deployment pipelines in partnership with QA and DevOps.
Technology Stack: React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, REST APIs, Domain-Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture,
Microservices, ETL Pipelines, Micro Frontend, Module Federation, System Design, LLD

entry.text: Senior Software Engineer    Feb 2023 – May 2025
Description: Scalable EdTech platform enabling students and professionals to access online courses, coding exercises, assessments, learning
resources, job opportunities, and analytics, built with React.js on the frontend and .NET Core Microservices with Entity Framework on the backend.
Responsibility:
• Developed responsive, reusable UI components using React.js, React Hooks, and Material UI for course catalogs, learner dashboards, and
assessment screens.
• Integrated frontend applications with .NET Core Microservices through RESTful APIs to power course enrollment, progress tracking, and
certification workflows.
• Modeled hierarchical and relational database schemas using the Entity Framework Code-First approach for courses, assessments, learning
resources, and job-opportunity modules.
• Designed and optimized complex SQL Server queries and stored procedures to support learner analytics and reporting dashboards at scale.
• Authored a SQL Server stored procedure and scheduled it as a daily SQL Server Agent job to automatically refresh learner-progress and course-
analytics data without manual intervention.
• Worked with Redis caching alongside SQL Server to improve response times for frequently accessed course and catalog data.
• Collaborated with Product Owners, QA Engineers, Architects, and DevOps teams in Agile Scrum environments; used GitHub for source control,
code reviews, and release management.
Technology Stack: React.js, JavaScript, Redux Toolkit, .NET Core Microservices, Entity Framework, SQL Server, SQL Server Agent Jobs, Redis,
REST APIs

entry.text: Software Engineer    Jan 2019 – Dec 2020
Description: Internet Banking System integrating the various levels of interaction between the bank and its customers, providing the necessary
interface for customers to avail banking services online.
Responsibility:
• Designed and implemented responsive user interfaces using React.js, Material UI, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
• Migrated key frontend modules to Next.js to enable server-side rendering, improving initial page load performance for banking dashboards.
• Built backend REST APIs using Nest.js alongside Express.js, introducing a modular, testable service architecture for banking transaction
workflows.
• Leveraged Next.js API routes for lightweight backend endpoints supporting account summary and transaction history features.
• Built reusable and dynamic frontend components using React Functional Components and Hooks; managed application state using Redux and
Redux Toolkit.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams following Agile Scrum methodologies.
• Integrated frontend applications with backend services using Axios and REST APIs.
• Structured backend services using Nest.js modules following Domain-Driven Design principles, separating account, transaction, and
authentication logic into bounded domain modules.
• Implemented event-driven notifications (webhooks and event listeners) for transaction and account activity updates, decoupling notification
handling from core transaction logic.
Technology Stack: React.js, Next.js, Nest.js, Redux, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, REST APIs, GitHub, Postman, Domain-
Driven Design, Event-Driven Architecture
CORE STRENGTHS
• Skilled in designing distributed, event-driven backend systems using Java 21, Spring Boot, and Kafka, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to
model complex business domains.
• Applies DDD consistently across ecosystems — bounded contexts and domain modules in Spring Boot as well as Nest.js — keeping business
logic decoupled from infrastructure and framework concerns.
• Experience building configuration-driven, versioned data models and hierarchical/relational structures that act as a foundation layer for multiple
dependent services.
• Comfortable designing event-driven workflows at different scales, from Kafka-based service integration to lightweight webhook/event-listener
notifications.
• Full-stack versatility across React.js/Next.js front ends (including data visualization and configuration UIs) and Java/Node.js/.NET backends.
• Comfortable translating real-world business structures into system models in collaboration with product and domain experts.
• Proven leadership directing offshore/distributed engineering teams, with strong stakeholder and client handling across cross-cultural,
geographically distributed teams.
• Strong systems-thinking and problem-solving abilities, balancing flexibility versus control in configuration-heavy systems.
• Working knowledge of AWS cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, and Git-based CI/CD pipelines for automated, version-controlled deployments.
• Writes clean, well-documented, testable code and participates actively in code reviews to maintain quality and share knowledge within the team.
• Early adopter of AI-assisted engineering practices (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Claude AI, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer) to speed up
coding, debugging, and documentation.
• Comfortable working across banking, healthcare, EdTech, and telecom domains, adapting quickly to new business rules and compliance needs.
